name: aware-mod
description: Usage awareness above the prompt: context bar, live 5h/7d plan limits synced across terminals, and weekly spend

display.title: Where to draw
display.description: band: a coloured row above the prompt. status: a plain pinned status line under it.

ctxTarget.title: Context target (tokens)
ctxTarget.description: Soft context target the bar fills toward

ctxBar.title: Context bar
ctxBar.description: Draw the context as a bar; off shows the compact 'ctx 62.7k' label

cautionPct.title: Caution at (%)
cautionPct.description: Yellow at or above this percentage

warnPct.title: Warn at (%)
warnPct.description: Red and a warning at or above this percentage

weekBudget.title: Weekly budget ($)
weekBudget.description: API-key users: colour the 7d dollars against this; 0 is off

alerts.title: Threshold toasts
alerts.description: Toast once when a gauge enters the warn band
